title: Run a Coding Agent From Your Phone
description:
Which coding agent should you use in 2026? In this video I'm going with Codex — in my opinion the best agent out there right now — specifically Codex CLI, which runs in a headless environment so you can execute it straight from your phone.

It's currently leading many benchmarks, can run faster than Claude Code, and is significantly cheaper on a subscription basis, with usage that's practically unlimited unless you're running it across 20 sessions around the clock. 

Here's how it fits into the workflow.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programmingTikTok
